title: 队列徽标 vs 列表

steps.js: const d=document.querySelector('.drawer'); const tab=[...document.querySelectorAll('.drawer-tabs button')][0]?.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); const t=(d||document.body).innerText; const m=t.match(/失败\s*(\d+)/g); const sel=[...(d?.querySelectorAll('select')||[])].map(s=>s.options[s.selectedIndex]?.text); return {tab, failedInList:m?m.slice(0,3):null, filters:sel};
